method: Same bill (tests/fixtures/39538.pdf), same process, same host, same pinned environment (PyMuPDF 1.28.2 / selenium 4.50.0 / pytest 9.1.1). The pre-change tree is a `git archive` of 962b37b extracted to /tmp/base962 and measured by the SAME script, interleaved BASE/AFTER twice to cancel machine drift. parse timings are min and median of 15 runs.
caveat: These absolute numbers are NOT comparable with the round-15 figures (51.33 ms) - that was a different sandbox host. Only the BASE-vs-AFTER pairs below, measured minutes apart on one host, are meaningful.

parse_document_39538_ms.verdict: No measurable change. Differences are smaller than the run-to-run spread of the baseline itself.

react_select_healthy_path.verdict: IDENTICAL DOM round-trip counts before and after. The recovery path costs nothing on a healthy portal because it is entered only when a read returns nothing readable or a node went stale mid-read.

recovery_path_cost.note: Only paid on a failure that previously ended the item as PARTIAL.
